question: My heart has been bound to the end of Arc 8 for a long time. Please tell us if Priscilla Barielle has any words for those of us in this state.
answer:
If possible, I don't want to write new words for Priscilla. Honestly, if possible, I don't even want to write Priscilla in flashbacks.

Her way of life was fully shown in Arc 8, and I believe she left all the words she needed to leave. The emotional burden on my heart is quite heavy... so regarding this, I'm sorry!
